context: A family conference. Hiroshi-elder is finally handing the family business decision over to his son Hiroshi-boss, with Ryosuke witnessing.
purpose: multi-generation business handover — formal family decision-making across three men

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今日は、店のことで集まってもらった。
lines.en: Today, I had you gather about the shop.
lines.style: Slow elder formal authoritative opener, the patriarch-weight audible, soft real gravity threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Boss tone softening into son-mode formal, the deep respect audible, soft real composure threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お父さん、お招きいただいて。
lines.en: Father, thank you for including me.
lines.style: Father warm formal respectful son-in-law cadence, the careful family-positioning audible, soft real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: もう、店を続けるのは難しい。お前に任せたい。
lines.en: I can't keep running the shop anymore. I want to leave it to you.
lines.style: Slow elder weighted vulnerable patriarchal disclosure, the careful handover-weight audible, soft real gravity throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Boss tone softening into careful son-questioning, the gentle real shock audible, soft real composure threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 本気だ。考えに考えて、お前しかおらん。
lines.en: Serious. I thought hard, and there's only you.
lines.style: Slow elder firm weighted patriarchal certainty, the careful real love-decision audible, soft real gravity throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お父さん、亮太さんの考えも聞いてからの方が。
lines.en: Father, maybe after hearing Ryota's thoughts.
lines.style: Father warm diplomatic careful intervention, the gentle bridge-keeping audible, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 責任の重さは、わかってる。でも、ちょっと時間欲しい。
lines.en: I understand the weight of the responsibility. But I want a little time.
lines.style: Boss tone careful responsible disclosure, the soft real weight audible, gentle real composure threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: もちろん。すぐ決めることじゃない。
lines.en: Of course. Not something to decide right away.
lines.style: Slow elder warm patriarchal patient softening, the soft real fatherly-respect audible, soft real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 妻とも、ちゃんと相談したい。
lines.en: I want to discuss it properly with my wife too.
lines.style: Boss tone warm careful family-extension, the soft real partnership-respect audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いい考えだと思います。家族みんなで決めることです。
lines.en: I think that's a good idea. It's something the whole family decides.
lines.style: Father warm diplomatic supportive observation, the gentle family-wisdom audible, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 亮介、ありがとうな。冷静な意見、いつも助かる。
lines.en: Ryosuke, thank you. Your calm opinions always help.
lines.style: Slow elder warm patriarchal acknowledgment, the soft real family-warmth audible, gentle real respect threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: No, if I can be of use.
lines.style: Father warm humble polite reciprocation, the soft real family-position audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 父さん、一か月だけ、時間ください。
lines.en: Father, please give me one month.
lines.style: Boss tone firm respectful son-request, the soft real composure-with-weight audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん、それでいい。ゆっくり決めなさい。
lines.style: Slow elder warm patriarchal closing acceptance, the soft real fatherly-love audible, gentle real warmth threading throughout delivery.
